name: Historical-US-mean-anchored marginal transport
interpretation: A conditional reference scenario for later US adults, not an identified estimate of their lipid distributions.
mapping: For marker j, y_j[i] = anchor_j * x_j[i] / arithmetic_mean(x_j). Apply separately to the ordered marginal columns; do not interpret matching row positions as people.

tc_mg_dl.provenance: Carroll et al., JAMA 2012, Table 1, 2007–2010, age-standardized US adults aged 20+, both sexes, all race/ethnicity groups and medication statuses.
tc_mg_dl.applicability_rationale: Transfer the earlier US mean as a reference level because its geography, adult eligibility and standardization match the intended population more closely than Mwanza. Assume no subsequent change in the mean for this scenario; this is not evidence that no change occurred.

hdl_mg_dl.provenance: Carroll et al., JAMA 2012, Table 1, 2007–2010, age-standardized US adults aged 20+, both sexes, all race/ethnicity groups and medication statuses.
hdl_mg_dl.applicability_rationale: Transfer the earlier US mean under the same explicit no-period-change reference assumption as TC.

scale_coefficients.provenance: Calculated deterministically from the supplied marginal grids and the historical US anchors.

shape_policy.retained: Within-marker rank, normalized quantile shape, coefficient of variation and log-scale dispersion of each supplied source grid.
shape_policy.rationale: Positive multiplicative transport changes location without introducing an unsupported new dispersion or tail parameter. The smaller admissible source lognormal scales are retained only as a provisional shape assumption, not as established US variability.
shape_policy.not_transferred: Mwanza joint ratio information, joint pairing, and source absolute cutoff frequencies are not calibration targets.

grid_interpretation: Rows are equally weighted marginal quantile representatives. Exact mean anchoring refers to their discrete arithmetic means. Later pairings must preserve these marginal weights.
age_standardization: Anchors are already standardized to the projected US 2000 age distribution. Without ages or age-specific distributions, no additional direct standardization is possible; treating the transported aggregate shapes as standardized target marginal shapes is an assumption.
uncertainty_policy: No confidence interval is used as a person-level standard deviation. This deterministic reference scenario does not propagate mean-estimation uncertainty, temporal transport uncertainty or source-shape uncertainty.
